meta.titre: Separable phrasal verbs with pronoun objects

sections.contenu_markdown: With separable phrasal verbs, a pronoun object has only one correct position: between the verb and its particle — never after it.

sections.titre: Position of a pronoun object with separable phrasal verbs
sections.contenu_markdown: With separable phrasal verbs (such as 'tell off', 'switch on', 'turn off'), when the object is a pronoun (her, him, it…), the pronoun must be placed between the verb and its particle, never after the particle.
sections.formule_principale: verb + pronoun + particle (never verb + particle + pronoun)

sections.enonce_markdown: Choose the correct order: 'I (told off her / told her off) for leaving the office unlocked.'

etapes.justification: A pronoun object must go between verb and particle.

sections.conclusion_markdown: "I told her off for leaving the office unlocked."

items.erreur_markdown: Placing the pronoun after the particle ('told off her'), by analogy with a noun object ('told off Mary').
items.pourquoi_faux: While a noun object can go either before or after the particle ('told off Mary' or 'told Mary off'), a pronoun object can ONLY go between the verb and the particle.
items.correction_markdown: Remember: with a pronoun object, the particle must always come last — no exception.

items.enonce_markdown: Put in the correct order: 'Please (switch it on / switch on it).'

items_markdown: Noun object: can go before or after the particle
Pronoun object: must go between verb and particle only
